scenario: [LEXP.10.2.2] refuses division or modulo by a literal zero only when every operand is `Int`; 'a `Float` division by a zero literal is not an error ([LDET.3.6.2])', because a Float operand makes the operation IEEE's, ±Inf or NaN. Two shapes, one per way a Float enters: a Float dividend over the Int literal `0` (`s.x / 0`), and an Int dividend over the Float literal `0.0` (`s.n / 0.0`). PATH PINNED: `lexp_10_2_2_zero_divisor` in dsc.validate; a walk that read only the divisor would refuse both; its sibling LEXP.10.2.2 keeps the all-Int refusal.
rules_ds:
schema S scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    n: Int mutable
    x: Float mutable

rule float_dividend:
    S s where s.x / 0 > 5.0
->
    log info "x"

rule float_divisor:
    S s where s.n / 0.0 > 5.0
->
    log info "n"
